q1.sampleAnswer: On a cold, dry February afternoon in 2017.

keyPoints.descZh: 2017 年二月一个寒冷干燥的下午
examples: On a cold, dry February afternoon in 2017.

q1.rubricZh: 要点：2017 年 2 月的一个下午（寒冷干燥）。
q1.explanationZh: 第一段开头就写了：2017 年二月一个又冷又干的下午。

evidence.quote: It was a cold, dry February afternoon in 2017.

keyPoints.descZh: 否定回答：孩子们没有受伤

q2.rubricZh: 要点：No, they weren’t.（孩子们没有受重伤）。
q2.explanationZh: 第二段说作者和孩子们都逃出来了，身体没有受伤，所以回答 No。

evidence.quote: My children and I all escaped the fire without physical injury.

q3.sampleAnswer: All of their possessions except for the clothes they were wearing.

keyPoints.descZh: 除了身上穿的衣服，所有财产（包括家）
examples: all of their possessions except for the clothes they were wearing

q3.rubricZh: 要点：除身上的衣服外，所有的财产都没了。
q3.explanationZh: 第二段说除了身上穿着的衣服，他们所有的东西都丢了，连鞋都没有。

evidence.quote: we lost all of our possessions except for the clothes we were standing in.

q4.sampleAnswer: Because he was autistic and had problems dealing with any changes.

keyPoints.descZh: 他患孤独症，很难应对任何变化
examples: Because he was autistic and had problems dealing with any changes.

q4.rubricZh: 要点：儿子有孤独症，难以应对任何变化。
q4.explanationZh: 第四段说儿子患有孤独症，很难接受任何变化，连换一双新鞋也接受不了。

evidence.quote: My autistic son really had problems dealing with any changes.

q5.sampleAnswer: The kindness of people who helped her and her family.

keyPoints.descZh: 帮助她和家人的人们的善意
examples: The kindness of people who helped her and her family.

q5.explanationZh: 最后一段说，人们的善意是最让作者难忘的事。

evidence.quote: Their kindness is what has really stuck in my mind.

q6.sampleAnswer: I would offer my home for her and her family to live in. I would buy some daily necessities, new clothes, and toys for her children. I would help her take care of her autistic son and her youngest daughter with asthma.(Answers may vary.)

keyPoints.descZh: 提出第一条合理的帮助方式
examples: I would offer my home for her and her family to live in.

keyPoints.descZh: 提出第二条合理的帮助方式
examples: I would buy some daily necessities, new clothes, and toys for her children.

q6.rubricZh: 开放题：至少写出两条合理的帮助方式（如提供住处、买生活用品和衣服玩具、帮忙照顾孩子等），每条 1 分。
q6.explanationZh: 可以从文中一家人的困难想：他们没有房子，没有衣服和玩具，孩子需要照顾。针对这些困难说出至少两点帮助即可。

evidence.quote: We lost our home. We had nowhere to live.

q7.explanationZh: “从笼子里逃出来”，has escaped 是现在完成时，escape 的过去分词是 escaped。

evidence.quote: My children and I all escaped the fire

q8.explanationZh: decide not to do sth. 后面要接动词原形，“不接受这份工作”用 accept。

evidence.quote: He couldn’t even accept the fact

q9.explanationZh: be frightened of 是“害怕做某事”，意思是一个人走夜路很害怕。

evidence.quote: I couldn’t help but feel frightened.

q10.explanationZh: “几周后收到她的电话”，前面有主语 I，要填动词过去式 received。

evidence.quote: until we could receive some money

q11.explanationZh: thanks for your kindness 是“感谢你的好意”，空格前是 your，后面要填名词 kindness。

evidence.quote: Their kindness is what has really stuck in my mind.

q12.explanationZh: I was thankful that … 是“我很庆幸……”，会议没开太久，所以我很感激。

evidence.quote: I was just thankful that my kids were all alive.

accept: broke out in the living room

q13.explanationZh: “着火了”是 broke out（突然发生），“在客厅”是 in the living room。

evidence.quote: a fire broke out in my autistic son’s room

accept: all escaped the fire without physical injury

q14.explanationZh: “逃出火灾”是 escaped the fire，“毫发无损”是 without physical injury，all 放在 escaped 前面。

evidence.quote: My children and I all escaped the fire without physical injury.

q15.explanationZh: “不禁做某事”是 couldn’t help but do，后面接动词原形；“欣慰”这里用 feel thankful。
q15.tipsZh: can’t help but do sth. 不禁……

evidence.quote: I couldn’t help but feel frightened. I was just thankful that my kids were all alive.

accept: except for the clothes we were wearing
except for the clothes we were standing in

q16.explanationZh: “除了……”用 except for，“身上穿的衣服”是 the clothes we were wearing。

evidence.quote: except for the clothes we were standing in

accept: until we found a new house

q17.explanationZh: “在……之前不得不”要用 until，“找到新房子”用过去式 found a new house。

evidence.quote: But until we could receive some money, we had to live with friends and family

accept: not just on the day the fire broke out, but also in the weeks afterwards
not only on the day the fire broke out, but also in the weeks afterwards

q18.explanationZh: “不仅……而且……”用 not just … but also …，课文里的原句就是这样写的。
q18.tipsZh: not just … but also … 不仅……而且……

evidence.quote: not just on the day the fire broke out, but also in the weeks afterwards
